Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: [placeholder] This policy explains how the Jat Bhawan Trust, Najafgarh handles personal data under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: [placeholder] For donations: name, father's or husband's name, village, gotra (optional), mobile number, email (optional), PAN (only if an 80G receipt is issued), amount, fund and payment reference. For hall enquiries: name, mobile number, event details. For members: name, father's name, gotra, village, member type, and phone number (only with consent).

use.title: Why we use it
use.body: [placeholder] To issue receipts, keep the Trust's accounts, show the donor wall as each donor chooses, respond to hall enquiries and maintain the member list. We do not sell personal data or use it for advertising.

display.title: Your donor wall choice
display.body: [placeholder] When you donate you choose one of: show name and amount; show name but hide the amount; or anonymous, where "Anonymous" is shown instead of your name. Your mobile number, email and PAN are never shown publicly.

members.title: Member phone numbers
members.body: [placeholder] A member's phone number is shown on the website only if the member has given clear consent. Members can withdraw consent at any time and the number will be removed.

rights.title: Your rights and removal requests
rights.body: [placeholder] You may ask to see, correct or remove your personal data, or withdraw consent, by contacting the office. Some records (such as receipts) must be kept for the period required by law, but they can be hidden from public pages. Grievance officer: [placeholder name, phone, email].

retention.title: Storage and security
retention.body: [placeholder] Data is stored with reputable service providers in secure systems with restricted access. It is kept only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law.

Terms.title: Terms of use
body: [placeholder] This website is run by the Jat Bhawan Trust, Najafgarh.
[placeholder] Information on the website is provided in good faith. The Trust may update it at any time.
[placeholder] Hall bookings are confirmed only after the office confirms in writing and the advance is received.
[placeholder] Any dispute is subject to the jurisdiction of the courts of New Delhi.

Refund.title: Refund & cancellation policy
body: [placeholder] Donations are voluntary and are generally not refundable.

[placeholder] If an amount was deducted by mistake or twice, contact the office within 7 days with the payment reference. Verified errors are refunded to the original payment method within 7 to 10 working days.
[placeholder] Hall booking cancellations and advance refunds follow the rules given at the time of booking.
